name: std::swap(std::map)

declarations.code:
template <class Key, class T, class Compare, class Alloc>

void swap(std::map<Key, T, Compare, Alloc> &lhs,

    std::map<Key, T, Compare, Alloc> &rhs)

    noexcept(/* see below */);

intro: Specializes the std::swap algorithm for std::map. Swaps the contents of lhs and rhs. Calls lhs.swap(rhs).
